title: Saul's Foolish Sacrifice and the Loss of the Kingdom
description: Saul waited seven days at Gilgal, but when Samuel did not arrive and the people began to scatter, he offered the burnt offering himself. When Samuel arrived, he declared that Saul had acted foolishly and broken the Lord's command, and therefore his kingdom would not endure. The Lord has sought out a man after His own heart to be ruler over His people.
